resources.string: Choose your language, review the project information, then configure access. You stay in control of optional permissions.
Root, LSPosed and precise location are required. Other permissions support optional features and can be enabled later in Settings.

Collected environment records and settings are stored on this device. If you configure external map or environment services, requests can send coordinates and credentials to those providers. Review their terms before enabling them. Bluetooth access reads paired-device metadata; it does not start a Bluetooth scan. Optional permissions can be revoked in Android settings.
I have read and agree to the project information, responsible-use requirements and disclaimer above.
Allow WeRePosition in your root manager, then check again. Root is used to publish simulation state and control the location runtime.

In LSPosed, enable WeRePosition and select System Framework. Restart the device after changing framework scope. Add apps that need Wi-Fi, cell or Bluetooth overrides, then restart those apps. Leave Google Play services and Fused Location out of scope. Return here and check again.
Allow precise location while using the app to start the location foreground service and read your current position. If you previously denied it, open Android settings.
Display over other apps is needed only for the floating joystick. Fixed-point and route simulation do not require it.
Show simulation status and a stop action in notifications. Denying this permission does not prevent setup.
Read cellular information for environment collection. Needed only when using the relevant collection features.
Import names and addresses of paired classic Bluetooth devices into specified connections. No scanning or pairing is started.
For environment access while the app is in the background. First allow foreground location, then choose Allow all the time in Android location permission settings if you need it.
Open LSPosed from its notification or manager shortcut, enable WeRePosition and select System Framework.
